title: The Silverwood Threshold
summary: Blackened briars creep across the lantern road beneath the Whispering Canopy.

art.caption: Ancient silver birches arch over a runed waystone bleeding pale emerald mist.

relicCard.caption: Carved Dryad Bark-Seal — click to flip & decipher

text: Silver leaves fall like frost-bitten coins along the border path. Where Oakhaven's timber-wards once held the wildwood back, tar-black thorns now coil around the waystone, drinking its emerald glow.

Sylvi, a bruised canopy scout, leans against a lantern post. "The Elder Heart-Tree stopped singing at moonrise," she murmurs. "Vaelen the Dryad Sentinel turned his roots on our patrols—and something colder watches from the hollow."
Two routes wind beneath the boughs: the moss-buried Pilgrim's Way, or the overgrown Briar Ravine where fresh tracks glint with black sap.

choices.label: Decode the waystone runes to trace the blight's arcane source.

relicBypass.bonusText: Moonstone Prism Lens reveals the cipher automatically (+100 Mastery)

choices.label: Follow the blackened sap prints quietly into the Briar Ravine.
"If trees start holding grudges, I'm charging the guild hazard pay." Press Sylvi for old fey shortcuts.

title: Shrine of the Three Winds
summary: A forgotten silver shrine hums above a brook choked with dark thorns.

art.caption: Weathered alabaster arches frame a silent belfry wrapped in luminous moss.

relicCard.caption: Inscribed Silver Belfry — click to flip & test the fey riddle

text: High above the brambles stands a pre-Concord shrine where three hanging bells once kept the canopy's peace. Two have been shattered by cold-iron wedges stamped with a jagged crown sigil.
Whoever poisoned the Heart-Tree did not stumble here by chance—they hammered Veil-iron straight into the ley-roots to turn Vaelen mad.
Before you can extract a sample, a low snarl rises from the brook as a Blighted Thorn-Stalker uncoils from the mist.

choices.label: Stand your ground and cut down the Blighted Thorn-Stalker.
Mask your scent in silver moss and slip around the beast toward the Root Vault.

title: The Sap-Stained Ravine
summary: A ruined smuggler's camp holds Veil-iron spikes and a scorched ledger.

art.caption: Snapped iron wedges and vials of pitch-dark sap litter a mossy gully.

relicCard.caption: Abandoned Fey Satchel — click to flip & solve the chime cipher

text: Tucked beneath a fallen birch lies an abandoned camp bearing the mark of the Hollow Crown—cultists who serve the encroaching Aether Veil. Their crates hold cold-iron spikes forged specifically to siphon a heart-tree's life.
A half-burned order reads: 'Once Silverwood falls, Lake Vesper's mirror will crack next.'
Heavy footsteps crunch along the ridge above—a Blighted Thorn-Stalker has caught your scent.

choices.label: Ambush the Thorn-Stalker before it alerts the grove!
Purge the Veil-iron crates with an arcane ward and hurry to the Heart-Tree.

title: The Choking Thicket
summary: Living thorns close the forest trails, forcing a brutal climb to the Elder Glade.

art.caption: Luminous roots pulse crimson and emerald behind a wall of snapping thorns.

text: The forest closes behind you like the ribs of a sleeping giant. Razor-edged vines whip across the path as Veil mist pools around your boots.
Ahead, the immense trunk of the Elder Heart-Tree towers against the moon, its crown flickering between pale silver and diseased violet-black.
You can hack straight through the briar wall or rally your voice to call out to the trapped spirit within.

choices.label: Hew through the briar barricade with raw strength.
Speak the old Oakhaven pact-words to calm the restless roots.

title: The Elder Heart-Tree
summary: Vaelen the Hollow-Bough rises from the poisoned roots, crowned in cold-iron spikes.

art.caption: A towering sentinel of silver bark and bleeding thorns guards the fractured Heart-Tree.

text: In the center of the glade stands the Elder Heart-Tree—wide as a keep, its glowing amber heart pierced by a jagged Veil-iron spike. Out of its roots steps Vaelen the Hollow-Bough, once the forest's gentle guardian, now armored in weeping black thorns.
"Mortal steel brought the spike!" Vaelen's voice cracks like splitting oak. "None leave the Canopy while the root bleeds!"
If you hold the Heartwood Chime or the Moonstone Lens, you spot the exact harmonic fracture pinning the curse to Vaelen's chest.

choices.label: Ring the Heartwood Chime to shatter Vaelen's curse and purify the Heart-Tree!

relicBypass.bonusText: Heartwood Chime triggers the Golden Path Purification (+100 Mastery)!

choices.label: Engage Vaelen the Hollow-Bough in battle to wrench the Veil-iron spike free!
"I didn't hammer iron into your ribs, Vaelen—the Hollow Crown did. Let me pull it out before we trade blows."

relicBypass.bonusText: Moonstone Prism Lens exposes the Veil-iron sigil to Vaelen (+100 Mastery)

title: Roots of Wrath
summary: Vaelen lunges in blind agony; only steel or desperate escape remains.

art.caption: Thorn spears erupt from the moss as the corrupted Dryad Sentinel charges.

text: The Veil-iron spike flares violet-crimson, drowning out reason. Vaelen raises a sweeping bough wreathed in blackened sap and strikes the earth, splitting the glade in two.
There is no more time for quiet bargains—face the guardian or retreat to warn Oakhaven before the blight reaches the gates.

choices.label: Meet Vaelen blade-to-bough and sever the corruption!
Torch the creeping border vines to buy Oakhaven time and fall back.

title: The Heart-Tree Blooms Anew
summary: Vaelen is freed without bloodshed and swears the Canopy's oath to Oakhaven.

art.caption: Luminous silver blossoms drift across the moonlit glade as the ley-roots heal.

text: As the cold-iron spike slides free and shatters into harmless dust, a rush of warm emerald starlight sweeps outward from the Elder Heart-Tree. Black thorns wither into silver moss.

Vaelen kneels upon the restored loam and presses a glowing amber leaf-charm into your palm. "The Canopy remembers mercy, Wayfarer. When you climb toward the Star-Spires, the wind will carry your name."
You return to Oakhaven beneath a gentle rain of silver petals—and carrying proof that the Hollow Crown has moved on to Lake Vesper.

ending.headline: Savior of the Whispering Canopy
ending.epilogue: Silver blossoms blanket Oakhaven's timber eaves as Vaelen renews the ancient peace between bastion and wood.

title: The Blight Severed
summary: Vaelen falls, the Veil-iron spike is destroyed, and Silverwood begins its slow recovery.

art.caption: Morning light breaks through the clearing canopy as emerald shoots sprout from charred thorns.

text: Your final blow cracks the cold-iron spike lodged in Vaelen's chest. The corrupted sentinel exhales a sigh like winter wind and dissolves into a ring of silver saplings around the Heart-Tree.
The blight halts at the edge of Oakhaven's fields. Though the forest mourns its fallen keeper, your blade saved hundreds of townsfolk—and revealed the Hollow Crown's trail toward Lake Vesper.

ending.headline: Breaker of the Silverwood Blight
ending.epilogue: New emerald shoots rise around the Elder Glade while Oakhaven's bells ring in gratitude for your steel.

title: Ash Along the Boughs
summary: You hold the blight back from Oakhaven's walls, though the deep wood remains shadowed.

art.caption: Smoke curls along the western timberline as dawn rises over a wary bastion.

text: Your firebreak halts the creeping thorns a bowshot from Oakhaven's stone walls. The town is safe for another season, yet deep within the Whispering Canopy the Elder Heart-Tree still groans under Veil-iron.
Archivist Seraphina reads the intelligence you salvaged with grave eyes. "We bought time—now we must strike the Hollow Crown before Lake Vesper falls."

ending.headline: Warden of the Western Wall
ending.epilogue: Oakhaven stands unbroken behind charred watch-lines, though watchful eyes still glimmer in the western trees.
